title: Adding Spaces to a String
goal: Insert spaces before the requested original character indices.
strategy: The supplied positions refer to the original string. A separate pointer into those positions avoids shifting later indices as output grows.

phasePurposes.done: Insert spaces before the requested original character indices.

edgeCases: An insertion at zero produces a leading space
Adjacent insertion indices each precede one character
An empty insertion list leaves the text unchanged
